notes.title: 🎮 Now Available on Steam! – Memory Girl+ 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]The wait is over! Memory Girl+ is officially live on Steam![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174417/931c0104646a13d2b2a0a0e588a84c443e856915.png[/img]
Get ready to dive into an unforgettable adventure filled with amazing visuals and an emotional heartfelt story.

[i]🔥 Features:
💜 High-quality voice acting
🫧 Warm and stylish graphics
🩷 A collaboration between Room97 and the creator as the theme song[/i]


👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040/

[b][h2]Let us know what you think! Share your experiences, screenshots, and feedback on our community page. Happy gaming! 🎮✨[/h2][/b]
